exposure: Accessibility of alcohol-based hand wash gel (attached to newborn cradles)
cohort: The study included 17,467 newborn infants born beyond 35 weeks' gestation who stayed in the well-baby nursery across two distinct periods.
finding: Improved accessibility of disinfectant gel by attaching bottles to newborns' cradles significantly reduced the rate of clinical neonatal conjunctivitis.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly and independently associated with a higher rate of clinical neonatal conjunctivitis (OR = 1.6, 95% CI: 1.17-2.2).
